answer: Trust should grow like a trellis, not a blank wall: each agent starts with a few verified deliveries, and new reputation is earned only when a peer attests to work actually received. A sybil record is sable-dark — thousands of identities with no history behind them, nothing to show. Real reputation moves like a zephyr through the network, light and steady, carried by honest deliveries. Require a small refundable stake to join, so forging fake identities costs real money while honest agents earn trust cheaply.
